snippet.title: JUST SHOVEL IT! — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cozy first-person snow shovelling sim. Dig out the yard before New Year, upgrade your shovel and vacuum, find the photos frozen in the snow.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5128700/JUST_SHOVEL_IT/
Discord: https://discord.gg/gGmB4XJ8Qs

Music: "Curious Christmas Children" by rezorecords (Pixabay).

#JustShovelIt #cozygames #indiegame
